name: DisCaseSummary
description: Aggregated DISP regulatory reporting record — a half-yearly snapshot of complaint volumes, outcomes, and categories per product type. Owned by SVC-015 (Compliance Core). Used for FCA DISP 1.10 reporting.

fields.name: reporting_period_start
fields.description: Start of half-yearly reporting period (1 Jan or 1 Jul)

fields.name: reporting_period_end
fields.description: End of half-yearly reporting period (30 Jun or 31 Dec)

fields.name: product_category
fields.description: FCA-defined product category for DISP reporting

fields.name: complaints_received
fields.description: Total complaints received in period for this product category

fields.name: complaints_upheld
fields.description: Total complaints upheld or partially upheld

fields.name: median_resolution_days
fields.description: Median calendar days from receipt to close

fields.name: sla_breach_count
fields.description: Count of complaints exceeding 8-week DISP SLA

fields.name: submitted_to_fca
fields.description: True when DISP report has been submitted to FCA

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Timestamp when this summary was generated

relationships.description: One DisCaseSummary aggregates many ComplaintCases for a reporting period
